nombre: Titular en banda + producto ancho + ficha de íconos con precio
descripcion: Fondo gris claro con una foto de contexto de uso muy desenfocada y lavada. Arriba, el nombre del producto en dos niveles, levemente inclinados: una línea negra condensada y, debajo, una banda negra a todo el ancho con la palabra clave gigante en amarillo y un ícono de línea temático al lado. En el centro, dos variantes del producto grandes y superpuestas en diagonal. Abajo a la izquierda, una lista de 5 características con pictograma negro y texto corto; abajo a la derecha, un círculo amarillo grande con el precio y el envío. Se lee de arriba abajo: qué es, cómo se ve, qué tiene y cuánto cuesta.
ad_format: Banded Headline Product Spec Sheet with Price Circle Ad
reference_style: Bold retail product ad: a slightly tilted two-level condensed headline whose keyword sits huge in yellow on a full-width black band, two product variants overlapping diagonally in the center, and a bottom row with an icon spec list on the left and a big yellow price circle on the right, over a pale blurred context photo

art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The giant yellow keyword on the black band. 2) The two product variants in the center. 3) The big yellow price circle at the lower right. 4) The first headline line above the band. 5) The five-row icon spec list at the lower left.
art_direction.composition_style: Vertical three-tier stack: a tilted headline block across the top, a wide product zone in the middle, and a bottom row split into a spec list on the left and a price circle on the right. The black band and the headline line above it are rotated about -4 degrees (rising to the right), which adds energy. The two products overlap along a diagonal from the upper right to the lower left, the back one higher and to the right.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline line 1: from about 5% to 69% of the canvas width, tilted with the band (its letters span about 6.5-13% of the height at the left end and about 3-10% at the right end), left-aligned. Black band: full width, about 17% of the canvas thick, top edge from about 14% of the height at the left to 7% at the right, bottom edge from about 31% at the left to 24% at the right (rotated about -4 degrees). Keyword on the band: from about 6% to 61% of the width, vertically centered in the band, left-aligned with line 1. Thematic icon: inside the band, right of the keyword, from about 64% to 79% of the width and 9% to 21.5% of the height. Products: back unit from about 37% to 92% of the width and 25% to 50% of the height; front unit from about 14% to 82% of the width and 38% to 69% of the height. Spec list: five rows from about 3% to 55% of the width and 65% to 98% of the height (row pitch about 7.5%); pictograms about 5-6% of the canvas at about 3-12% of the width; texts from about 13.5% of the width. Price circle: about 30% of the canvas in diameter, from about 66.5% to 96.5% of the width and 67% to 97% of the height.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Background: very light grey with a heavily blurred, washed-out photo of the context of use (in the original, a car interior seen through the windshield), almost white. Products: bright studio light with glossy reflections on the surfaces, crisp edges and a soft shadow between the two units and under them. Band, text, pictograms: flat graphic. Price circle: radial amber-yellow gradient, slightly deeper orange toward the edge, with a thin lighter rim and a soft warm glow around it; two thin black decorative arcs inside it, one above and one below the price, follow the circle's curve.

layout_summary: Square canvas with a pale grey background showing a washed-out blurred context photo. At the top, a black condensed uppercase line, and right under it a full-width black band, both tilted about -4 degrees, with one giant yellow condensed keyword and, inside the band to its right, a yellow line icon (theme of the keyword). In the center, two variants of the user's product (for example two colors) overlapping diagonally and large. At the lower left, five rows each with a small black pictogram and a short dark text. At the lower right, a large amber-yellow circle framed inside by two thin black arcs, with a giant black price spanning almost its full width and a small white shipping line under it.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Suggests the context of use without competing with the product
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Very light grey base with a heavily blurred, washed-out photo of the place where the product is used (car, desk, kitchen, bathroom, outdoors), faded almost to white so it never competes with the text or the product.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Full width, about 17% of the canvas thick, from about 14-31% of the height at the left edge to 7-24% at the right edge (rotated about -4 degrees, rising to the right)
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: High-contrast stage for the headline keyword; the most distinctive element of the format
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid black band crossing the full width, slightly tilted, holding the giant keyword.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Inside the band, right of the keyword, from about 64% to 79% of the canvas width and 9% to 21.5% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Illustrates the keyword at a glance
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Simple outline icon in the keyword's yellow, literally representing the keyword or the moment of use (for example a moon, a sun, a drop, a bolt, a snowflake). One icon only.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Center: back unit from about 37% to 92% of the width and 25% to 50% of the height; front unit from about 14% to 82% of the width and 38% to 69% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Shows the product large and its options or variants
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Render two units of the user's product exactly as in the attached product photo (same geometry, materials and colors), overlapping diagonally: two real variants or colors of the product if the user has them, otherwise the same product from two different angles. The front unit is fully visible.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower left, from about 3% to 55% of the canvas width and 65% to 98% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Technical sheet that justifies the price
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Five rows, each with a small black pictogram (solid or line, about 5-6% of the canvas) literally representing its feature, followed by a short dark text. All pictograms in the same visual weight. No boxes or dividers.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Lower right, about 30% of the canvas in diameter, from about 66.5% to 96.5% of the width and 67% to 97% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Makes the price the second strongest focal point after the headline
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Solid circle with a radial amber-yellow gradient (or the brand's warm accent), a thin lighter rim and a soft warm glow, with two thin black decorative arcs inside it (one above and one below the price), holding the giant price and a small shipping line. Use the exact price and currency the user gave.

text_layers.reference_position: Top left, directly above the band, from about 5% to 69% of the width, tilted with the band
text_layers.text_style: Bold condensed sans-serif, uppercase, black, about 6.5% of the canvas height, 1 line, left-aligned, tilted with the band
text_layers.guia_texto: La categoría del producto o lo que es, de 2 a 4 palabras; se completa con la palabra clave de la banda.

text_layers.reference_position: On the black band, left-aligned with line 1
text_layers.text_style: Ultra bold condensed sans-serif, uppercase, yellow or the brand's warm accent, about 12% of the canvas height, 1 line, left-aligned, vertically centered in the band and tilted with it
text_layers.guia_texto: La palabra clave que define el diferencial o el momento de uso del producto (para cuándo, para qué o para quién), en 1 palabra, máximo 2.

text_layers.reference_position: Lower left, right of each pictogram
text_layers.text_style: Semi-bold sans-serif, near-black, about 2.3-2.5% of the canvas height, max 2 lines per row, left-aligned
text_layers.guia_texto: Cinco características concretas, una por fila, de 3 a 8 palabras cada una: diseño o material, protección o tecnología, calidad o rendimiento, comodidad y el mecanismo que lo hace funcionar.

text_layers.text_style: Ultra bold rounded sans-serif, black with a faint light halo, about 12% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, spanning almost the full width of the circle
text_layers.guia_texto: El precio real que dio el usuario con su moneda. Solo cifra y moneda.

text_layers.reference_position: Inside the price circle, under the price
text_layers.text_style: Bold sans-serif, white, about 2.3-2.5% of the canvas height, 1 line, right-aligned under the price, between the price and the lower arc
text_layers.guia_texto: La condición real de envío del usuario, en 2 palabras.

mandatory_visual_elements: Full-width black band, slightly tilted, with a giant yellow keyword and a thematic line icon
Black condensed headline line above the band
Two product units or variants overlapping diagonally in the center
Five-row spec list with black pictograms at the lower left
Big amber-yellow price circle with two thin black inner arcs at the lower right
Pale, washed-out blurred context photo as background
forbidden_additions: Struck-through old price or discount percentage badge
Trust seals, guarantee or certification badges
Boxes, cards or dividers behind the spec rows
notas_paleta: Alto contraste negro y amarillo: banda negra con la palabra clave y el ícono en amarillo intenso (o el acento cálido de la marca); primera línea del titular, pictogramas y textos en negro; círculo de precio en degradado amarillo ámbar, algo más naranja hacia el borde, con dos arcos finos negros, el precio en negro y el envío en blanco. Fondo gris muy claro y lavado.
